title: .config/ianf-script-kinds.toml, version 1
description: The kind of each script a tool requires outside scripts/dev/ and scripts/server/, and of each of the application's own entry points, for script-kinds, which reads each worktree's own copy. See script-kinds' README.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

kinds.description: Each script's path from the repository's root, with its kind: dev if it runs on a developer's machine or in CI, server if it runs on the target host or image, app if it's the application's own entry point, such as a framework's console.
